constraints: One project parcel may map to multiple UPRNs.
One UPRN may map to multiple project parcels only when qa_state is ambiguous or an authoritative one-to-many relation is documented.
GeoPackage FID must never be used as a persistent join key.
Promotion requires captured OS package version JSON and compatible source epochs.
Promotion requires geometry source and geometry epoch.
Promotion requires current Ofcom evidence and explicit premise-level or approved postcode-level semantics.
Spatial fallback cannot be promoted without a documented distance/containment rule and ambiguity handling.
